request.style: English, traditional hymn, mixed four-part choir, pipe organ, brass quartet, timpani on the last verse, reverent and stately, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Upon a hill outside the gate
They raised a cross of wood
And there the Son of God was hung
Where we ourselves had stood

[Verse]
The crowd went by and shook their heads
And mocked him as he died
The soldiers gambled for his clothes
And pierced him in his side

[Verse]
The message of the cross is called
But foolishness by some
Yet unto us who are being saved
The power of God has come

[Verse]
I will not boast in anything
But in the cross of Christ
The world is crucified to me
And I to it have died

[Verse]
Now let the proud lay down their crowns
The wise their clever word
For in this foolishness we find
The wisdom of the Lord
